**graph:** two definitions with the same qualified name and kind in one file (the same spec helper `def` in two `describe` blocks) each keep their own symbol, the second under `<uid>~2` as pixel-mvp writes it. The second no longer replaces the first, so calls are not linked to the wrong copy and no edge or unresolved call is left on a missing caller. The graph rebuilds once (extractor version 31).
